title: 6LU7 · a protein and its binding pocket (Draft)
description: The same plan as Drafts only: a start Card and three Drafts that state what each step takes and gives, ready for the Agent's "Generate Cards".

cards.summary: Fetches the PDB file of 6LU7 (the SARS-CoV-2 main protease with the inhibitor N3) from RCSB PDB and passes it on as a folder. Shows the size and SHA-256 of the files fetched.
details: Fetches the PDB file of 6LU7 (the SARS-CoV-2 main protease with the inhibitor N3) from RCSB PDB and passes it on as a folder. Shows the size and SHA-256 of the files fetched.

outputs.note: The result of fetching the 3D structure

cards.summary: Reads the ATOM / HETATM records of the PDB and takes out the coordinates of the protein's Cα atoms and of the inhibitor (chain C, a parameter). Shows them as a 3D point cloud, Cα in blue and the inhibitor in red, and logs the number of residues and atoms per chain.

cards.summary: Shows, as a table of the shortest distance and the number of atoms in contact, the residues within cutoff Å of the inhibitor's atoms (the contact residues). Draws a contact map from the matrix of Cα distances, and keeps an image marking the pocket's residues as a file.

notes.html:
6LU7: the main protease and the inhibitor N3

A crystal structure of the novel coronavirus's main protease (Mpro) with the inhibitor N3 covalently bound (Jin et al., 2020).

Contact residues are those where the distance between a protein atom aa and an inhibitor atom ll

dal=∥ra−rl∥d_{al} = \lVert \mathbf{r}_a - \mathbf{r}_l \rVert

is dal≤dcd_{al} \le d_c (cutoff of pocket, 4 Å by default). You can check that the catalytic His41 and Cys145 are among them.

intro: A Draft is a Card that says in words what it receives, what it does and what it passes on. It has no code yet. With "Generate Cards" in the app, the Agent writes code from these words, runs it and checks.
